rationale: SRC_BDC01 flags eligible current-period BDC source rows missing from private_markets_holdings. The raw filing source is readable and targeted issuer searches locate all three flagged issuers in the current-period investment schedule before the current-period Total Investments line of 29,484.8 million. Because the source rows exist with investment type, rate terms, dates, cost, and fair value, the absence of corresponding pipeline output rows is a real extraction coverage error rather than a false alarm.
